shell:
node --version
npm --version
npm install -g @arxo/cli@0.2.4
law version --json

  --program corpus/clir/openstax-chemistry-acids.lawir.json --imports \
  contexts/openstax-chemistry-acids.json --out "$chapter2_explain"

  contexts/openstax-chemistry-acids.json --out "$chapter4_why_not"

python3 reader_tools/prepare_question.py corpus/laws/doctrine/math/euclid-pythagoras/tests/05-pyle-033.lawtest \
  --program corpus/clir/grc-euclid-pythagoras.lawir.json --imports \
  contexts/grc-euclid-pythagoras.json --out "$chapter5_why_not"

chapter6_graph=$(mktemp -d)
python3 reader_tools/prepare_question.py corpus/laws/doctrine/math/euclid-pythagoras/tests/01-aigyptiako-345.lawtest \
  --program corpus/clir/grc-euclid-pythagoras.lawir.json --imports \
  contexts/grc-euclid-pythagoras.json --out "$chapter6_graph"
law engine graph "$chapter6_graph" --json

mkdir -p "$chapter6_work/clir"
cp clir/grc-euclid-stoicheia-i.lawir.json "$chapter6_work/clir/"
law engine lower "$chapter6_work/euclid-pythagoras" \
  --imports contexts/grc-euclid-pythagoras.json \
  > "$chapter6_work/clir/grc-euclid-pythagoras.lawir.json"
law engine lock "$chapter6_work/euclid-pythagoras" --clir "$chapter6_work/clir" \
  --write
law pack --project "$chapter6_work/euclid-pythagoras" \
  --out "$chapter6_work/modified-release" --json
cp "$chapter6_work/modified-release/world.lawir.json" \
  "$chapter6_work/modified.lawir.json"
law engine test "$chapter6_work/case234.lawtest" --program \
  "$chapter6_work/modified.lawir.json" --imports contexts/grc-euclid-pythagoras.json

chapter6_graph=$(mktemp -d)
python3 reader_tools/prepare_question.py "$chapter6_work/case234.lawtest" \
  --program "$chapter6_work/modified.lawir.json" --imports \
  contexts/grc-euclid-pythagoras.json --out "$chapter6_graph"
law engine graph "$chapter6_graph" --json

python3 reader_tools/prepare_question.py corpus/laws/doctrine/math/hilbert-grundlagen/tests/01-gerade-meidet-punkt.lawtest \
  --program corpus/clir/de-hilbert-grundlagen.lawir.json --imports \
  contexts/de-hilbert-grundlagen.json --out "$chapter7_explain"

python3 reader_tools/prepare_question.py bar.lawtest \
  --program corpus/clir/myco-opredelitel.lawir.json --imports \
  contexts/myco-opredelitel.json --out "$chapter8_why_not"
law engine why-not "$chapter8_why_not"

chapter8_why_not=$(mktemp -d)
python3 reader_tools/prepare_question.py corpus/laws/org/scrum/guide/tests/08-book-hidden-work-prevails-by-priority.lawtest \
  --program corpus/clir/scrum-guide.lawir.json --imports contexts/scrum-guide.json \
  --out "$chapter8_why_not"
law engine why-not "$chapter8_why_not"

law engine lower "$chapter8_work/guide" > "$chapter8_work/without-priority.lawir.json"
law engine test \
  corpus/laws/org/scrum/guide/tests/08-book-hidden-work-prevails-by-priority.lawtest \
  --program "$chapter8_work/without-priority.lawir.json" --imports \
  contexts/scrum-guide.json

python3 - <<'PYTHON'
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
source = Path("corpus/laws/org/ietf/bcp14/sources/rfc2119/en.txt")
print(sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PYTHON

cp mechanics-study/law.lock mechanics-bad-pin/law.lock
law install --project mechanics-bad-pin --offline
law test mechanics-bad-pin

mkdir water-study
cp -R docs/books/postroeniya-alt/examples/voda/. water-study
law install --project water-study --offline

law ask water-study --case Voda \
  --query 'evaluate truth(
    openstax.chemistry_acids::amphiprotic(
      entity_ref("urn:case:kniga:h2o")
    )
  );' \
  --query-id amphi --out water-answer

cp -R water-study water-recipient
law install --project water-recipient --offline
law ask water-recipient --case Voda \
  --query 'evaluate truth(
    openstax.chemistry_acids::amphiprotic(
      entity_ref("urn:case:kniga:h2o")
    )
  );' \
  --query-id amphi --out recipient-answer
cmp water-answer/result.json \
  recipient-answer/result.json

law eval water-answer
law inspect water-answer/result.json summary
